message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Short-Term Earnings Acceleration", "construction": "Compute the change in quarterly earnings growth rate: (most recent quarterly EPS - EPS one quarter ago) minus (EPS one quarter ago - EPS two quarters ago), divided by stock price. Use data from quarterly filings.", "rationale": "Rapid acceleration in earnings growth may signal improving prospects not yet fully priced in.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Net Buyback Yield", "construction": "Annual net share repurchases divided by market capitalization, using Compustat data for shares outstanding and CRSP for market cap.", "rationale": "Firms reducing share count may be signaling undervaluation or strong cash flows.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Labor Efficiency Ratio", "construction": "Annual sales per employee (from Compustat) divided by total assets.", "rationale": "Firms generating more revenue per employee relative to their asset base may be more efficient and profitable.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Inventory Change Scaled by Sales", "construction": "Annual change in inventories divided by annual sales, both from Compustat.", "rationale": "Rising inventories relative to sales may signal demand overestimation and future underperformance.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Insider Buying Concentration", "construction": "Number of shares purchased by insiders in the past 6 months divided by total shares outstanding, using SEC Form 4 filings.", "rationale": "Substantial insider buying may reflect private information about future prospects.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Deferred Tax Asset Ratio", "construction": "Total deferred tax assets divided by total assets, from Compustat annual statements.", "rationale": "Low levels may indicate aggressive revenue recognition or fewer tax shields, possibly linked to conservative accounting.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Long-Term Debt Maturity Proximity", "construction": "Portion of long-term debt due within next 2 years divided by total long-term debt, from Compustat.", "rationale": "Imminent debt maturities may create refinancing risk, affecting future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Gross Profitability to Market", "construction": "Gross profit (sales minus cost of goods sold) over the past 12 months divided by market capitalization.", "rationale": "Firms with higher gross profitability relative to price may be undervalued.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "R&D Scaling Ratio", "construction": "Annual R&D expense divided by total assets, from Compustat.", "rationale": "Firms investing more in R&D may experience future innovations and growth not yet priced in.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Change in Working Capital Ratio", "construction": "Annual change in net working capital divided by total assets, calculated from balance sheet data.", "rationale": "A declining working capital ratio may indicate improving operational efficiency.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}]}
